key.name: look
key.description: silik: the title bar is the command line, a text rail of keys, a status bar. bar: one bar across the bottom, the applications as icons. island: one floating piece centred at the bottom.

key.name: accent
key.description: ink: one ink on paper, the look as it was. steel, cobalt, silicon (silicon indigo), volt (volt violet), spark (spark yellow): what is selected, focused, on or running takes that colour; text, frames and the mark stay ink on paper. NAME-vivid: the title bars too, in a deep tone of it. `silik look --accent` sets this key and the GTK and shell themes SilikOS-NAME with it.

key.name: glass
key.summary: Glass: the floating panes over a blur of what is behind them
key.description: true: the island (or the bar), Start and the COMMAND bar are paper at 0.86 over a blur of what is behind them, with their muted text darker so that it reads at 4.5:1 on any background. false: solid paper. The Silik look's title bar, rail and status bar are solid either way. `silik look --glass on|off` sets this key.
